about_the_game:
Grove Bound is a cozy incremental woodcutting RPG with a twist there’s no combat.

Instead of fighting enemies, the world itself is the challenge. The grove is wrapped in darkness, lit only by your lantern and the occasional campfire. Some paths will be blocked, but with a bit of planning, better tools, and upgraded skills, you can work your way through and even shape the grove to your advantage.

There’s no rush here. No ticking clock. Just you, your axe, and a quiet forest to explore at your own pace.

Features

  • Chop, Mine, Fish, Cook & Craft
    Spend your days gathering, crafting, and slowly improving your tools as you settle into life in the grove.

  • Find Your Favourite Gear
    Discover and upgrade equipment that suits your playstyle some might even hold little secrets.

  • Wander into the Grove
    Take your lantern and explore at your own pace. The deeper you go, the more there is to find.

  • Pack What Matters
    Your bag is small, so choose carefully. Bring what you need and make the most of what you find.

  • Meet the Neighbors
    Get to know a cast of friendly, slightly odd locals. Help them out, and learn their stories over time.
    Little Mysteries Everywhere
    Poke around, try things out, and uncover hidden corners of the world.

  • A Gentle Pace
    Keep yourself fed and rested, but there’s no pressure take each day as it comes.
    With cute pixel art visuals and a cozy mysterious atmosphere, Grove Bound is about progress, planning, and finding comfort in the unknown one tree at a time.
